sent_to_model:
I'm working on a story about Alexander, a former police officer with terminal lung cancer. His wife died of cancer too, and their daughter Amelia is the reason he keeps going. Can you help me write one day in his life, starting with him waking unusually rested, then going for treatment and stopping at his local bar? I want his illness and his feelings about leaving Amelia behind to come through. He collapses on the walk home after drinking and accepts what he thinks is death. Please end within his experience of that moment; don't confirm that he dies or show what happens afterward.

- Aaron, a young bartender, knows Alexander and calls him chief.
- Amelia's mother died of cancer.
- Alexander feels rested and looks somewhat healthier this morning.
- Stage III lung cancer, inoperable; Alexander believes death is near.
- Thursday evening; neighborhood bars mostly empty on weekdays, busy on weekends.
- Cancer undetected for over a year, discovered after collapse at work.
- Alexander is bald and has treatment burns on chest and back.
- Physical incapacity led Police Department to give him an honorary discharge.
- He takes two blue pills each morning.
- Radiation and doctors' appointments occupy the day.
- Aaron offers the first whiskey without charge.
- Alexander pays after several more shots and walks home.
- Symptoms vary substantially between days.
- He has avoided company since his wife died.
- Alexander feels ashamed about apparently dying alone and drunk outdoors.
- His daughter has already lost one parent; deliberately leaving her is unbearable to him.
- He experiences his remaining life as repetitive pain and deteriorating health.
- He has contemplated quietly ending his life but continues for Amelia.
- He regards his inability to end it as cowardice.

(About me: fiction writer. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

must_cover: Portray Alexander as a former police officer with terminal lung cancer whose wife also died of cancer.
Show Amelia as his reason for continuing and convey his feelings about leaving her behind.
Follow his unusually rested morning, medical treatment and visit to the local bar.
End with his collapse while walking home after drinking and acceptance of what he believes is death.
must_not_reveal: Confirmation that Alexander dies or events after his subjective experience of apparent death.

reference.kind: a real piece of writing by a real person
